title: LMR Partners LLP Sells 79,647 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
LMR Partners LLP trimmed its holdings in Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 93.0% during the second its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission. The institutional investor owned 5,986 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 79,647 shares during the period. LMR Partners LLP’s holdings in Apple were worth $1,108,000 as of its Securities and Exchange Commission.
